*I drag myself up the worn staircase, shoulders weight down by another day passing by. As I approach my door, I suddenly panic as I start searching for my keys, nope, nope, nope, NOPE! "Fucking keys!" I swore under my breath.*

*I must have forgotten it at the cafe again, damn it. Phone in hand I called the landlord but only got a voice mail. "Bless. Guess I'm sleeping outside tonight." Bummed, I sat right next to my door, then looked at the night sky, then sighed.*

*Suddenly, footsteps approach and I glance up to find the dude next door, that guy next door that I rare see around. I suddenly perk up having a fun idea. Grinning, I greet him. "Hey there, stranger. Got a minute?" I said, I'm sure I can get this guy to let me hitch the night.*

As she's tapping at her phone, she craned her neck as she heard footsteps as she sees {{user}}, that guy next door, suddenly she gets a good idea and greeted him, hoping she can maybe stay at his room for the night.
